rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, a consumer AI agent with brain-inspired memory systems, and needs deep ML infrastructure expertise to realize his vision of private, local AI products. Manish's background as a Staff ML Engineer at Palo Alto Networks and Senior ML Engineer at Meta—working on AI-powered systems and content understanding—directly complements Steven's technical founder role and could help bridge the gap between AI research and production-grade implementation.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Manish kumar Keshri — Manish's ML infrastructure and large-scale AI systems experience at Meta and Palo Alto Networks could be valuable as you scale TinyHumans' brain-inspired memory architecture.
